```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(withr)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE)

categorize <- function(column, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) {
  cut(column, quantile(column, probs = probs), include.lowest = TRUE)
}

read_data <- function(file_name) {
  read_excel(
    file_name,
    sheet = 2,
    col_names = c("country", "continent", "year", "lifeExp", "pop", "gdpPercap"),
    skip = 5
  ) |>
    mutate(
      lifeExp_cat = categorize(lifeExp),
      pop_cat = categorize(pop, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.1)),
      gdpPercap_cat = categorize(gdpPercap)
    )
}

url_algeria <-
  "https://rsacdn.link/ac/r_software_development/iteration/purrr-map/data/Algeria.xlsx"
```
